### Hidradenitis suppurativa — CPRD codelist

Includes diagnostic synonyms, site-specific diagnoses, and follicular occlusion triad/tetrad diagnoses, which include hidradenitis suppurativa. Codes are reproduced as returned by the CPRD tools.

| CPRD code | Recorded term |
|---|---|
| `M25y1-1` | Hidradenitis suppurativa |
| `M25y1` | Hidradenitis |
| `EGTON66` | Hydradenitis suppurativa |
| `^ESCTHI346451` | Hidradenitis axillaris |
| `^ESCTVE346453` | Verneuil's disease |
| `^ESCTSU346454` | Suppurative hidradenitis |
| `^ESCTRE667046` | Retro-auricular cysts (hidradenitis) |
| `^ESCTAX667047` | Axillary hidradenitis suppurativa |
| `^ESCTAN667048` | Anogenital hidradenitis suppurativa |
| `^ESCTVU667049` | Vulval hidradenitis suppurativa |
| `^ESCT1501708` | Hidradenitis suppurativa of multiple sites |
| `^ESCTFO669402` | Follicular occlusion triad - hidradenitis, acne conglobata, dissecting cellulitis of scalp |
| `^ESCTFO669403` | Follicular occlusion triad |

A diagnostic code indicates the condition at the time recorded; it does not, by itself, establish ongoing activity at a later index date.

## Hidradenitis suppurativa codelist

Includes diagnostic terms, synonyms, site-specific forms, and follicular occlusion syndromes that include hidradenitis suppurativa. Codes and descriptions are reproduced as returned by CPRD.

| CPRD code | Description |
|---|---|
| `M25y1-1` | Hidradenitis suppurativa |
| `M25y1` | Hidradenitis |
| `EGTON66` | Hydradenitis suppurativa |
| `^ESCTSU346454` | Suppurative hidradenitis |

**Excluded:** Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis, hidradenomas/hidradenocarcinomas, nonspecific sweat-gland disorders, and procedures that do not independently establish the diagnosis.
